column18: Mappable: No. Mediation Inconsistency: DOLCE's temporal-region is a subclass of DOLCE's abstract. DOLCE's abstract is disjoint to DOLCE's perdurant. DOLCE's perdurant is equivalent to BFO's Occurrent. BFO's TemporalRegion is a subclass of BFO's Occurrent. This inconsistency is a result of the OWL DisjointClasses class axiom. In this equivalence relation. both DOLCE's temporal-region and BFO's TemporalRegion are subclasses of two classes that are disjoint. hence the two classes cannot be equivalent. Mediation Method: Manual
